allow: PowerShell($py = if \(Test-Path .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe\) { ".venv\\Scripts\\python.exe" } else { "python" }; & $py -c "from app.services.google_auth import gmail_client, _load_credentials; c=_load_credentials\(\); print\('scopes:', c.scopes\); print\('profile:', gmail_client\(\).users\(\).getProfile\(userId='me'\).execute\(\)\)")

PowerShell(python -c "from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials; from google.auth.transport.requests import Request; c=Credentials.from_authorized_user_file\('credentials/token.json'\); print\('scopes:', c.scopes\); print\('expired:', c.expired, 'has_refresh:', bool\(c.refresh_token\)\); c.refresh\(Request\(\)\); print\('refresh OK'\)")
